predictions.selection_reason: executes zip with file list from user-controlled directory -> potential command injection via filenames
predictions.source_summary: File paths come from grain directory mounted at /tmp/tmp/data via bind mount from user-provided grainDir parameter. Files are enumerated recursively from the current directory (which is /tmp after pivot_root) using listDirectory().
predictions.sink_summary: zip command executed with -@ flag reads file list from stdin. File paths are written directly to zip's stdin via pipe without shell escaping.
predictions.guard_summary: findFilesToZip function filters out files containing newlines to prevent command injection via filename newline characters. Sandbox environment isolates the process with namespace and mount restrictions.
predictions.risk_pattern: User-controlled file paths from grain directory are passed to zip command via stdin without proper escaping beyond newline filtering, potentially allowing zip command injection through specially crafted filenames.
called_function_context: findFilesToZip() recursively processes files and filters newlines
enclosing_conditions: if (!restore) branch - only in backup mode, not restore mode
predictions.context_summary: The zip command is executed in a sandboxed environment with file paths coming from user-controlled grain directory. While newlines are filtered to prevent basic injection, other special characters in filenames may still affect zip command behavior.
unresolved_facts: Whether zip command properly handles other special characters in filenames beyond newlines
Whether the sandbox environment fully prevents escape or privilege escalation
What specific zip command-line parsing vulnerabilities might exist with the -@ flag

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in a Command ('Command Injection')
top_sast_rules.description: Externally influenced data changes the syntax or meaning of a command sent to a downstream command interpreter.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-77 command-injection command-construction shell exec spawn process subprocess child_process os.system popen argument-delimiter metacharacter
top_sast_rules.remediation: Keep external data separate from command syntax and use safe argument APIs.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')
top_sast_rules.description: Extracting files from a potentially malicious tarball using `shutil.unpack_archive()` without validating that the destination file path is within the destination directory can cause files outside the destination directory to be overwritten. More precisely, if the tarball comes from a user controlled location either a remote one or cli argument.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Implement path validation using canonical paths. Reject paths containing '../' or similar traversal sequences.
